taxRules.bracketsDescription: Jordan uses a progressive tax system where different portions of your income are taxed at different rates. The rates apply to your annual taxable income after exemptions.
taxRules.nationalContribution: An additional 1% national contribution tax applies for individuals with income exceeding JOD 200,000 annually.
taxRules.exemptionsDescription: These amounts are deducted from your gross annual income before calculating the tax.
taxRules.socialSecurityDescription: Employee contribution rate for social security insurance.
taxRules.socialSecurityNote: This is mandatory for Jordanian employees and is deducted from your monthly salary.

exemptIncome.pension: First JOD 2,500 of monthly pension salary
exemptIncome.disability: JOD 2,000 annual exemption for people with disabilities
exemptIncome.diplomatic: Income of diplomatic and consular staff

taxRules.residencyDescription: An individual is considered a tax resident if present in Jordan for 183 days or more in a calendar year. Both residents and non-residents are taxed only on income sourced in Jordan.

taxFiling.deadlineDescription: Personal income tax returns must be filed before April 30th each year.
taxFiling.deadlineNote: The same deadline applies for final payment of taxes owed.
taxFiling.portalsDescription: Jordan offers several online platforms for tax filing and payment. These e-government services make it easy to file and pay taxes from anywhere.
taxFiling.stepsTitle: How to File Your Tax Return
taxFiling.stepsDescription: Follow these steps to file your income tax return online through the eTax portal:

register.title: Create an Account
register.description: Register on the eTax portal (etax.istd.gov.jo) using your national ID number.

login.title: Log In to the Portal
login.description: Access your account and navigate to the tax return section.

fill.title: Fill the Tax Return Form
fill.description: Enter your income details, exemptions, and deductions for the tax year.

review.title: Review Your Information
review.description: Double-check all entered information and calculated tax amounts.

submit.title: Submit the Return
submit.description: Submit your completed tax return electronically through the portal.

pay.title: Pay Any Tax Due
pay.description: If you owe tax, pay through eFawateercom or at authorized banks.

taxFiling.employeesDescription: If you work for a single employer, your company handles most tax obligations on your behalf.

employerTasks.withhold: Withholds tax monthly from your salary
employerTasks.submit: Submits the tax to ISTD on your behalf
employerTasks.certificate: Provides you with an annual tax certificate

taxFiling.whenToFile: You may still need to file if:

fileWhen.claimExemptions: You want to claim additional exemptions
fileWhen.exceedExemptions: Your total exemptions exceed employer's calculation

taxFiling.advanceDescription: For taxpayers with gross income exceeding JOD 1 million in the previous year:
taxFiling.advanceNote: Advance payments are required within 30 days after each half-year period ends.
